title: Robot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#1f3a5f'/>
  <!-- legs in dancing pose -->
  <rect x='34' y='74' width='9' height='18' rx='3' fill='#3fa9f5' transform='rotate(-14 38 83)'/>
  <rect x='57' y='74' width='9' height='18' rx='3' fill='#3fa9f5' transform='rotate(16 61 83)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8c42' transform='rotate(-14 31 90)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff8c42' transform='rotate(16 68 90)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='32' y='46' width='36' height='32' rx='7' fill='#5fd1d1'/>
  <rect x='36' y='52' width='28' height='20' rx='4' fill='#2a8f8f'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='3' fill='#ffe25e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='3' fill='#ff6b8b'/>
  <!-- left arm raised, waving -->
  <rect x='14' y='40' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#3fa9f5' transform='rotate(-40 18 51)'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='36' r='6' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- right arm out, boogie -->
  <rect x='77' y='52' width='9' height='20' rx='4' fill='#3fa9f5' transform='rotate(60 81 62)'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='71' r='6' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='40' width='10' height='8' fill='#2a8f8f'/>
  <!-- head with LED face screen -->
  <rect x='30' y='16' width='40' height='30' rx='8' fill='#5fd1d1'/>
  <rect x='35' y='21' width='30' height='20' rx='5' fill='#0e1a33'/>
  <!-- happy glowing eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='3' fill='#7dfaff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='29' r='3' fill='#7dfaff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 36 Q50 41 57 36' stroke='#7dfaff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head antenna, bobbing -->
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='54' y2='7' stroke='#ff8c42' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ffe25e'/>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <path d='M70 20 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5z' fill='#ffe25e'/>
</svg>
